column1: # Reviewed Tomcat JarScanFilter policy for every deployed Phase 5e/5f context.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# Tomcat walks every WEB-INF/lib JAR of every context twice at startup: once for
# Jasper's TLD scan and once for the Servlet pluggability fragment pass. The six
# routed contexts carry 124-127 JARs each (66,100-68,064 nested entries) and the
# API WAR carries 37. In run 33290776432 that cost 13-15 minutes per context and
# roughly 21 minutes for ADInterface, deployed serially, so
# :startPhase5fRoutedLane never became ready inside any usable budget.
# The reviewed <JarScanFilter> on each context descriptor suppresses both walks.
# Suppression is only safe while the archives genuinely contain nothing a scan
# would have found, so this file records the exception set and
# verifyPhase5fJarScanPolicy proves it against the built WARs. A JAR that starts
# shipping a TLD, a web-fragment.xml, a ServletContainerInitializer service
# entry or META-INF/resources/** fails that gate rather than silently losing the
# behaviour at runtime.
# SEMANTICS (verified against StandardJarScanFilter.check in the shipped
# tomcat-util-scan.jar of Tomcat 10.1.59, not assumed):
#   defaultTldScan is true, so for a TLD scan Tomcat returns
#   matchName(tldScanSet, jar) when matchName(tldSkipSet, jar) is true, and true
#   otherwise. With tldSkip="*.jar" the allowlist below is therefore the exact
#   and complete set of JARs still scanned for tag libraries.
#   The same branch governs PLUGGABILITY. With pluggabilitySkip="*.jar" and an
#   empty pluggabilityScan, no application JAR is opened for fragments at all.
# Setting tldScan REPLACES the container default
# (tomcat.util.scan.StandardJarScanFilter.jarsToScan, which lists only log4j and
# slf4j taglib JARs). None of those are present in any deployed WAR, so the
# replacement removes nothing.
# NOT COVERED BY tldSkip: a TLD outside a JAR. /wstore ships
# WEB-INF/webStore.tld, which Tomcat finds through its /WEB-INF walk regardless
# of this filter. It is recorded here so the omission cannot be mistaken for an
# oversight.
# Columns: context, jar, scan_type, reason
# The generated <JarScanner> sets scanClassPath="false", so this file is
# the complete allowlist for every JAR the filter can reach.
context
wstore
column4: The only JAR in any deployed WAR that ships META-INF TLDs; the 25 precompiled /wstore JSPs instantiate its tag handlers
